title: NeoTab
description: NeoTab is a lightweight Paper plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ that adds an animated tablist header with your server name and a dynamic footer showing real-time RAM, personal ping, and average ping – for now in a purple theme
body:
# NeoTab – Modern Animated Tablist for Paper

NeoTab is a lightweight and customizable tablist plugin for Minecraft Paper servers.

It adds a clean animated tab header, a dynamic footer with live server stats, and simple in-game commands — without turning your server into a lag machine.

NeoTab is built for lobbies, SMPs, challenge servers, small networks, and anyone who wants a modern tablist without bloated features or complicated setup.

---

## ✨ Features

### Animated Tab Header

Customize your server name with smooth animated styles:

* Rainbow
* Pulse
* Gradient Wave
* Static

The header supports MiniMessage formatting, gradients, colors, and custom text.

---

### Dynamic Tab Footer

Show useful live server information directly in the tablist:

* RAM usage
* RAM percentage
* Player ping
* Average server ping
* Online and max players

The footer is designed to be clean, readable, and lightweight.

---

### Performance Presets

NeoTab includes configurable performance modes so you can choose how often the tablist updates.

Available presets:

* `smooth`
* `balanced`
* `light`
* custom tick values

Performance settings are saved in the config and stay active after a restart.

---

### Optional Plugin Support

NeoTab can work on its own, but also supports optional integrations:

* PlaceholderAPI
* LuckPerms

These plugins are not required. NeoTab will still run without them.

---

## 🕹 Commands

Main command:

```text
/tab
```

Examples:

```text
/tab setname <name>
/tab style <style>
/tab footer
/tab refresh
/tab reload
/tab performance <preset>
```

All important changes can be applied in-game without restarting the server.

---

## 🔐 Permissions

```text
neotab.admin
neotab.reload
```

More permissions may be added in future updates as NeoTab grows.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

NeoTab is designed to be simple to configure.

You can customize:

* server name
* animation style
* update interval
* custom colors
* footer format
* performance mode
* bold header animation
* optional integration behavior

MiniMessage formatting is supported for clean modern colors and gradients.

---

## 🚀 Performance First

NeoTab is built to stay lightweight.

* No heavy calculations every tick
* Async-safe design where needed
* Adjustable update speed
* Optional light mode for lower overhead
* Designed for servers that care about performance

---

## ✅ Compatibility

NeoTab 1.1.1 targets modern Paper servers and has been tested on:

* Paper 1.20.6
* Paper 1.21.x
* Paper 26.1.x
* Paper 26.2 Beta

Older versions below 1.20.6 are not planned, because NeoTab uses modern Paper/Minecraft UI and text APIs.

Note: Paper 26.2 is currently treated as beta-tested compatibility.


---

## 🧪 Beta Notice

NeoTab is still in beta.

The plugin should already work well for testing and smaller live servers, but bugs can still happen while new features are being added.

Please keep your config backed up before updating between beta versions.

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports

Found a bug, console warning, PlaceholderAPI issue, LuckPerms issue, or weird tablist behavior?

Please report it on GitHub Issues:

```text
https://github.com/DasEtwa/NeoTab/issues
```

Please include:

* NeoTab version
* Server software and version
* Java version
* Installed plugins
* Console error or log
* Steps to reproduce the issue

Please do not report bugs only in Modrinth comments, because GitHub Issues are easier to track and fix.

## Why NeoTab?

NeoTab is for server owners who want a modern, clean, animated tablist without installing a huge all-in-one plugin.

Simple setup.
Good performance.
Clean visuals.
Easy customization.
